description: See which threads need you at a glance in a messenger-style sidebar with live status, folders, and project colours. Sub-agents and forks fold into their parent, so each task is one row. Attention, project, and section folders sit as tabs or a Telegram-style rail, each with unread badges. Projects get distinct colours you can change, and the + starts a chat in the open project. Search, pinned order, splits, and bb's thread shortcuts all keep working.
